App Description: With this app, you can configure and manage approval workflows for journal upload cases. This app helps you streamline the review and approval process before journal upload cases are posted, ensuring better control and compliance. Once the workflow is active, you can submit journal upload cases for approval before posting by using the  Submit for Approval  button in the  Manage Journal Upload Cases  app.   You can configure single or multi-step workflows that assign approval tasks based on case categories, subcategories, or organizational roles. You can set start conditions, configure responsible teams, and monitor approval status directly within the app. You decide when a workflow should start, who should approve it, and whether the case should be posted automatically after approval. Approvers receive tasks in their  My Inbox  app, where they can review, approve, or reject proposals. This ensures that journal entries are validated by the right people at the right time, improving accountability and reducing manual coordination.

App Description:
SAP aims to support continuous integration in an ABAP environment and to allow development processes in ABAP to be aligned with development processes that are commonly used for other development environments or languages.  This has two main components: 
 
 Git-based versioning, including branch and merge support 
 Options to connect your ABAP processes with continuous integration (CI) tools 
 
This will be provided by extending the ABAP Change and Transport System ( CTS ). This new set of CTS features is referred to as  git-enabled CTS  ( gCTS ).  Git repositories will be used to store released ABAP transport requests. To configure connections between Git repositories and ABAP, and manage commits / development objects stored in these repositories, a UI is provided which offers the following: 
 
 Subscribe to one or more Git reposititories where ABAP content is provided for the ABAP target systems 
 Trigger updates 
 Display the system"s attributes and also the subscribed Git repositories 
 Select one of the repositories, display its attributes, and the avalable commit IDs 
 Select one of the commit IDs to update the ABAP system with the content that is necessary to bring it to exactly the selected software state, or update a system to "the latest" state 
 Configuration options:register new repositories, edit existing ones, populate a new system with initial content, delete a repository subscription
Technical Catalog Title: SAP: Application Services

App Description: With this app, you can identify the business objects that contribute most to the data footprint by showing the related SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) objects. Alternatively, you can use the  Release for Delivery  app to adjust the confirmation data manually. You can use this app if the business role  Order Fulfillment Manager  (R0226) is assigned to your user.

App Description: With this app you can protect quantities of a material of a specific plant against other demands. Supply protection can be in the form of core (horizontal) protection where complete groups are protected against each other or in the form of prioritized (vertical) protection where every group is only protected against the demand of a group with a lower priority. Core and prioritized protection can be combined. A protected quantity is always defined for the combination between a material and a plant as well as one or more characteristics. The characteristics are typically attributes of the sales document or of the customer and can be assigned via a characteristics catalog. You can use this app if the business role  Order Fulfillment Manager  (R0226) is assigned to your user.

App Description:

App Description: During the MRP run, the system checks whether current material demand can be covered by current inventory and expected material receipts. In a regenerative MRP run, the system plans all materials irrespective of whether they have been changed since the last MRP run. In a net change MRP run, the system only includes materials that have been changed since the last planning run in the new planning run. If current demand is not covered, the system creates planned orders in the case of in-house production and either purchase requisitions or schedule lines for external procurement.   You can use this app to create and schedule a job for executing your MRP runs. To automate the planning process, the MRP run has to be carried out on a regular basis so you can use this app to create a job that performs this task for you; reducing your workload by running this task smoothly in the background.   This app is contained in the business catalogs  Retail Replenishment - DC Replenishment Execution  ( SAP_RFM_BC_DC_REPLNMT_PC ) and  Production Planning - MRP Runs  ( SAP_SCM_BC_MRPRUN_MC ). App Description: This app is available for project managers, and displays information about several aspects of the project.       Note         If a project contains blocked information, only a user with adequate authorization can view such information.      Transactions posted as periodic foreign currency valuations are excluded from the actual amounts.        The header area displays the following information:       Actual margin, calculated on the basis of actual cost and actual revenue      Margin (at completion), calculated on the basis of the estimated cost at completion (EAC) and the amount to be billed from the sales order      Margin (sold), calculated on the basis of actual cost and the amount to be billed from the sales order      Detailed information about the project is displayed in the following sections:       General Information   Displays basic information about a project, such as the project duration, customer, and accounting information.      Contacts   Displays the stakeholders assigned to the project, and their responsibilities.      Financial Information   Displays key financial indicators calculated up to the current calendar month. Note that the key figures always display amounts until the end of the month.      Work Performance   Displays aggregated key figures related to efforts planned in work packages. Note that this section aggregates information only for resources planned and assigned to work package teams.      Work Packages   Displays information about each work package, the total effort planned for the work package team, and the service quantity planned in a service-based work package.      Team   Displays information about planned and actual effort, and resource assignments to a work package team.       Note     If the advanced resource management solution has been activated in your system, the  Planned Hours (Up to Current Month)  column in the  Team  facet displays values based on staffed hours.        Additional Resources   Displays information about all additional resources planned in a work package.      Customer Invoices   Displays information about customer invoices that have been processed for a project.      Expenses   Displays information about expenses planned in a work package.       Note     You can only view information for expenses that were planned using the  Plan Customer Projects  app.        Purchase Orders   Displays the list of purchase orders assigned to a project, and information about each purchase order.       Note     To protect personal data, the app does not display purchase orders of suppliers that are blocked.        Forecast   Displays information such as the percentage of completion, estimate to complete, estimate at completion from the latest forecast for the project.      In addition, the app can also be used for the following purposes:       As a starting point to navigate to additional information relevant in your business context, such as detailed information about related master data, business partners, and documents.      To navigate to apps with additional functions, such as creating customer projects, planning customer projects, reviewing customer projects, and managing billing proposals and billing requests.

App Description: You can use this app to perform a monthly review of customer projects for percentage of completion (PoC) by cost and to adjust the estimate to complete (ETC). This app also provides an overview of various key performance indicators, displayed up to the forecast month or the current month.       Note         This app only displays projects that are in the  In Execution  stage.      Transactions posted as periodic foreign currency valuations are excluded from the actual amounts.        You can perform the following tasks for customer projects:       Display a list of projects that you are responsible for. You can also use filters to control the list of displayed projects.      View information such as PoC, cost deviation, effort deviation, actual margin, and the overall status of the project.      Carry out monthly reviews of projects by setting the forecast month. When you review a project, the system fetches actual postings only until the forecast month.   The system always sets the current month as the forecast month when you review a project for the first time. Subsequently, a new forecast month can be set only if the previous forecast is completed and the calendar month has changed.       Note     Forecast month in customer projects uses the universal time zone. Project forecast month can be set to the correct month, from the UI and from the background job, only when the local time and the universal time both lie in the same calendar month.        Navigate to view project-level KPIs and details of the project plan and actuals.        Forecast   In the  Forecast  area, you can do the following:       View project-level KPIs such as PoC, EAC trend, margin at completion, margin (sold), and deviations.   If the forecast month and the current month are different, then the app displays two views with information up to the corresponding months. Detailed plan information is displayed and project-level KPIs are calculated based on the active view ( Forecast Month  or  Till This Month ).      View the list of work packages, the planned roles, resources, and expenses, the corresponding planned and actual numbers, ETC, the resulting EAC cost, and the PoC for each item.       Note         Planned roles with similar attributes are grouped into a single row. Values in  Cost (Forecast)  and  Effort (Forecast)  are based on the sum of individual plan items in the corresponding row.      Work packages without a planned role or expense are not displayed for review.           View information about actual time postings for an item, by choosing the  Actual  link.      Update the estimate at completion, if necessary. This is possible only in the view for the forecast month.   If the actual effort or expense exceeds the plan, the ETC value is set to  0  (zero).      Use the  Recalculate  button to simulate the effect of ETC adjustments on individual rows and on overall project KPIs.   For resource-based work packages, the following steps are applied:       The system determines the average cost rate based on the total planned cost for each row.      The system calculates the variance (between planned and actual values) that must be adjusted into the plan of the current and future months of the respective work package.      The system  equally  distributes only the variance from previous months, into the current and future months of respective work packages.      The system calculates the ETC cost as a product of the average plan cost rate and ETC effort.      The system calculates the estimated cost at completion (EAC) as the sum of actual cost and ETC cost.      For service-based work packages, the system calculates the POC as  (Actual Units / Planned Units) * 100 .   The KPIs in the header section of the app are refreshed to display newly calculated PoC, margins, and deviations. The system also indicates values where the EAC is affected positively or negatively.      Save the changes to the project. This also results in a recalculation in the background.          Project Status   In the  Project Status  area, you can do the following:       Create a new entry to record the current status of the project, for parameters such as budget, staffing, and execution. You can also record the trend for each of these parameters.      Set the overall status of the project.      View a historical record of statuses and trends set for the project.          Versions   In the  Versions  area, you can view a comparative table that displays values for work packages across the baseline, the current plan, and the EAC.       Note     Note that the key figure for efforts represents only the efforts planned in a work package team.

With the reuse component for the Digital Signature (CA-DSG) you can sign and approve digital data (documents, objects etc.) in all applications that are set up for its use:
•	First, the user credentials of the signatory are validated. Validation process depends on the selected signature method.
•	After the successful validation of the user credentials, the digital data is digitally signed by the SAP system (system signature). The digital signature ensures that the signatory of a digital document can be identified unambiguously and that his or her name is documented together with the signed document, the date, and the time.

The digital signature is a class-based tool in the software component SAP_ABA (component CA-DSG). This component cannot be used alone; it can only be used in conjunction with an application.

Before you start renumbering your G/L accounts, please read the following information:       Renumbering G/L Accounts in a Two-System Landscape: Overview        Renumbering G/L Accounts in a Two-System Landscape: Process        Renumbering G/L Accounts in a Two-System Landscape: Before You Start        How to Renumber G/L Accounts (Two-System Landscape)         After you have released the mapping in this configuration activity, your administrator uses the  Convert Renumbered G/L Accounts  app to convert the values of the G/L accounts in the system. App Description: This app helps you, as a manager or owner of your company’s  order-to-cash  process, to get a comprehensive overview of the performance and conformity of all the sales order processes in your company. It provides key figures with respect to the duration of certain process steps in the  order-to-cash  process as well as to the number of occurrences of important events that have been triggered during process execution. With the help of these key figures you can easily determine the health status of your sales process and find potential areas of improvement at a glance.   Here are some activities you can perform with the help of the app:    Track delivery blocks or billing blocks     Detect changes made to critical fields of a sales order     Monitor lead times (for example, order to delivery or goods issue to billing)
Technical Catalog Title: CEC: Customer Engagement and Commerce - SD

•	Expenditure Detail – This report is designed to provide partners with more detailed information, which can then used to verify their share of the operator’s billable costs for the month.

•	Supplemental Detail – The Supplemental Detail Statement provides partners with additional detail information for user configured activities.  Examples of these types of activities are acquisitions, transfers, retirements or sales of controllable equipment or materials.  These transactions are individually detailed for each Venture/Equity Group combination, and detailed item descriptions are provided for each transaction.

App Name: Schedule Job for JVA Equity Change
UI Technology: SAP Fiori: Generic Job Scheduling Framework
App Description:
You use this feature when venture partners within an Equity Group may elect to transfer their interest to other parties. Pre-Cutback Equity Change and Equity Adjustment were designed to meet this requirement by accommodating ownership changes in both the current period and in prior periods.

Pre-Cutback Equity Change Management:
Changes in ownership during the current period may result in expenditures being posted across multiple Venture/Equity Groups. Pre-Cutback Equity Change gives the operator the opportunity to correct these transactions, and have all venture expenditures cutback to a single Venture/Equity Group combination.  This process reverses postings to the original Venture/Equity Group, and rebooks them to the active Venture/Equity Group combination at month end.  In addition, these adjustments are made only in the JVA ledgers, and the original entries in the originating R/3 modules are unaffected, therefore preserving the audit trail.

Equity Adjustment was designed to make retroactive changes at the Accounts Receivable level for prior period ownership adjustments. JVA determines the net change in share for each partner, as well as the operator, and posts an adjustment document to the affected partners.

App Description:
You use this feature to allocate the billable finance documents from S/4HANA Universal Journal for each joint venture and equity group to the non-operating partners and operating partner, applying the posting rules defined during configuration. 
The operating partner carries all of the operating costs of a venture throughout the accounting period.  JVA analyzes the expenditures that have been incurred, and creates the invoice amounts that will be billed to the partners.  This process typically occurs at the end of the accounting period after all transactions have been posted and allocations have been run. The process of allocating these transactions to both the operator and the non-operating partners according to their respective equity shares is referred to as Cutback.

Under certain circumstances, the operator may be required to be charge certain items directly to an individual joint venture partner; the JVA Cutback process recognizes these charges and posts a separate Account Receivable entry to the partner for these amounts.  Expenses for ventures that involve such special partnership arrangements as carried interest, net profit interest, or suspended partners, as well as suspended equity groups or projects are also processed by Cutback.  In addition, Cutback also assigns expenses to partners for non-operated “on-billing” ventures (ventures in which the company has sold portions of its non-operated partnership shares to another party).

To reduce the incidence of profit and loss from exchange rate differences, cutback also provides funding currency functionality.  The funding (or billing) currency is the currency in which the partners’ invoices are booked.  The relationship between funding and transaction currency is defined at the venture level, and may be either the transaction or the local currency.  Cutback determines the amount of the expenditure for all the transaction currencies that relate to one funding currency, and posts the partner invoices in the partner’s funding currency.  JVA also has Output Tax functionality that allows a tax code to be defined at the venture or partner level.  If the venture and /or partner is subject to an Output Tax, then a tax invoice will be calculated based upon the total expenditure for that partner and Venture/Equity Group during the Cutback process.  This tax amount is included as a separate line on the invoice to the partner so that it may be identified and managed separately.

It acts as a central navigation point for the access to the Master Data Remediation Worklist app as well as to analytical drill downs for data analysis. You can navigate to the target application for the remediation process and apply context-based filters using preselected values from the Master Data Remediation Overview app according to a specific evaluation setting. The evaluation setting is a mandatory filter ensuring that only the data of a specific evaluation setting is displayed. This enables the comparability of the displayed results in the context of the selected setting.   The information is displayed on a set of actionable cards. The Master Data Remediation Overview app displays the aggregated product information about the last evaluation run on these cards. The Master Data Remediation Overview app offers preconfigured content that aggregates the data according to Master Data Remediation specific attributes, such as rule violations and remediation status, or object specific attributes, such as product type and product group. Starting from the Master Data Remediation Overview app, you can use specific actions on the cards to drill down to selected products with errors to analyze them according to Master Data Remediation specific attributes or product related attributes or a combination of both.

Matching identifies match groups. Depending on certain parameters these match groups are either automatically approved or they are set to the status  Open . The status  Open  is set if the specified approval score is not met or if user interaction is required for example if a record matches with more than one active record. Open match groups should not be left in the process, but be reviewed by the user to be either approved or rejected.   The identified match groups can be processed in the best record calculation. If you set a checkpoint for matching the consolidation process stops after matching and enables you to check the matches in the match review.

App Description: Matching identifies match groups. Depending on certain parameters these match groups are either automatically approved or they are set to the status  Open . The status  Open  is set if the specified approval score is not met or if user interaction is required for example if a record matches with more than one active record. Open match groups should not be left in the process, but be reviewed by the user to be either approved or rejected.   The identified match groups can be processed in the best record calculation. If you set a checkpoint for matching the consolidation process stops after matching and enables you to check the matches in the match review.

App Description:
Application to configure SAP Replenishment Planning by specifying parameters that influence the replenishment calculation or its subprocesses.   The parameters include single control parameters and groups of parameters, called profiles. These parameters and the other structured objects are configuration objects.  Below is the list of the configuration objects: 
 
 
 A procurement schedule is a list of order, delivery, and availability dates and times that are used to determine a replenishment schedule for each product location. Create and manage procurement schedules using the Manage Procurement Schedules app. 
 
 
 A cost profile includes the parameters that are used to calculate the cost components that are considered within the replenishment calculation. Create and manage cost profiles using the Manage Cost Profiles app. 
 
 
 A shelf cost profile includes the parameter that is used to calculate the cost components regarding the shelf capacity. Create and manage shelf cost profiles using the Manage Shelf Cost Profiles app. 
 
 
 A constraint profile includes the parameters that are used to specify the constraints that are considered within the replenishment calculation. Create and manage constraint profiles using the Manage Constraint Profiles app.

App Description: You can use this app to perform activity-based time recording to enable billing and invoicing of projects assigned to you. You can also record time for non-project related tasks such as administration, training, travel time, and so on. The non-project task types can be assigned to both internal employees and contingent works.    The  Manage My Timesheet  app tile on the Fiori launchpad displays the number of missing hours for the logged-in workforce.      Note      The number of missing hours are calculated based on a configuration for the timesheet and can be displayed up to three digits on the app tile. The steps for configuration are as follows:      In your configuration environment, under  Human Resources , use the search function to open the following activity:  Define and Maintain Settings for Timesheet Application .      In the Time Recording view, under  Configuration Activities , choose  Configure  for the configuration step  Maintain Data Entry Profiles (SAP S/4HANA) .      Select a profile.      Enter a value for the field  Missing Days . Based on this value, the number of missing hours will be calculated.    Beyond three digit numbers, the number is rounded off to the closest possible value. For example, if a workforce has 140.50 missing hours, the hours will be displayed as 140k on the  Manage My Timesheet  app tile.      Example     Let's assume the default setting for the missing day configuration is 60 days, with a workforce schedule set at 8 hours per day, or 40 hours per week. Over a period of 60 days, the expected working hours would be 480. If the workforce records only 200 hours, 280 hours would be displayed on the app tile.            The  Manage My Timesheet  app also supports time recording for concurrent employment of internal employees.      Note     Time recording by contingent workers for concurrent employment is currently not supported.       If you have the business role  Employee Self Services  ( SAP_BR_EMPLOYEE ), you can perform the following tasks:       View the time entries already recorded in your timesheet      View all the tasks assigned to you      In the  My Tasks  side panel, you can view the following information:       A list of tasks assigned to you for the selected week       Note     Project tasks are displayed for the duration of the work package to which you are assigned.        A list of tasks grouped by accounting objects (like billable customer projects, non-project related task types, and so on)      The total number of hours recorded for each task (for the selected week)      You can also search a task from the  My Tasks  list.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP CA HCM: Fiori Apps

App Description: With this app, you as a project manager can send email reminders to the workforce who have not recorded the applicable time in the  Manage My Timesheet  app, as per the planned effort of the project. You can check information like planned effort, approved hours, unapproved hours, recorded hours, and missing hours of each project member. The app also displays details about project, workpackage, work item, and activity type associated with each staffed member of the workforce.    You also have an option to navigate to the  Manage My Timesheet  app and record or modify time entries on behalf of the workforce. You can also modify existing time entries or create new time entries in the  Manage My Timesheet  app on behalf of inactive employees during their last active employment period.      Note           You cannot modify time entries or create new time entries in the  Manage My Timesheet  app on behalf of inactive contingent workers.      The  Current Employement Status  field displays the employment status of the workforce as of the present date.      While recording new time entries on behalf of inactive employees, you cannot record time beyond the active employement period.       Example     The last working day of an employee is 1st June, 2021. However, his active employment period as defined in the system is till 30th June, 2021. You will be able to create time entries for that employee till 30th June, 2021. From 1st July, 2021, no new time entries can be created in the  Manage My Timesheet  app, for that employee.         The time entry details of the the inactive employees are visible in the  Manage My Timesheet  app for 60 days from the date when the employment is terminated. Post 60 days from the date of employment termination, you cannot modify existing entries or create time entries for that particular employee during their last active employment period.      Example     An employee was terminiated on 30th June, 2021. You can modify or create new time entries for that employee till 31st August, 2021. From 1st September, 2021, no changes are allowed in the  Manage My Timesheet  app for that employee.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP CA HCM: Fiori Apps

App Description: Using this application, you as an approver can approve or reject time entries. This application is embedded into the unified inbox called  My Inbox .   Now approval is enabled only for the project-related tasks by default. Other accounting object like WBS Element, Internal Order, Cost center, and non project related tasks are approved automatically by default. If you want to enable the approval for these accounting objects, then you have to implement the custom BAdI using extensibility. For more information, see  App Extensibility: Approve Timesheet - My Inbox . The related catalog must be assigned to the corresponding approver.       Note         This app supports approvals for both the internal employees and contingent worker timesheets.      This app supports approval of time entries for all the Accounting Objects (Customer projects, Internal Order, Non-Project related tasks, WBS Element, and Cost Center) supported by the timesheet.        If there are any time entries which have been submitted for approval before the Work package or WBS elements has been blocked for time recording, these corresponding time entries highlighted as critical entries in the  Approve Timesheet  UI. The user cannot approve these critical time entries. He/she can either reject these entries or approve them after unblocking the time recording for the relevant work packages.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP CA HCM: Fiori Apps

App Description: With this app, you can create and assign allocation tags. Allocation tags are semantic tags you can assign to allocation cycles and segments that allow you to group and identify those cycles and segments. The tags can be used across allocation contexts and types, allowing you to track and label all elements of an allocation process.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Controlling Apps: Fiori Apps

App Description: With this app, you can organize allocation cycles into groups to enable parallel processing. If you don't organize your allocation cycles into groups, the cycles are always processed sequentially. This can be time consuming. A cycle run group can be processed concurrently with other cycle run groups, so you can significantly reduce the processing time if you organize your allocation cycles into groups. The allocation cycles within a single group are processed sequentially, but can be processed concurrently with other groups.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Controlling Apps: Fiori Apps

App Description: With this app, you can upload values to allocation segments. The values can be amounts, rates, or portions. It allows you to download value combinations from allocation segments into an excel file template, then upload the changed file to the app. After upload, you validate the changes in the app and apply them to your segments. You can also use the app to download an excel file that highlights any errors in an allocation segment. The app works for all allocation contexts and types except for top-down distribution.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Controlling Apps: Fiori Apps

App Description: You can use this app to display how the total costs of a selected cycle are allocated from each individual sender to the receivers in a network graph. App Name: Material Inventory Values - Rounding Differences (Design Studio)
App Description: You can use this app to gain an understanding of the rounding differences between the current inventory postings of the actual inventory and the calculated inventory (Quantity   Price) during a ledger fiscal period.  Rounding differences arise because the prices and price units produce values that cannot be represented in the minimum currency units (EUR with 2 decimal places, for example).  After analyzing the rounding differences, you can react appropriately. For example, you can arrange for new materials to be posted in the future with higher or lower prices.  Depending on the role to which you re assigned, you can perform the following tasks:   View the inventory value and quantity sorted by company code, G/L account, material, fiscal year, ledger fiscal period, and plant (standard layout)  Analyze potential rounding differences in detail with an extensive number of attributes such as fiscal year, ledger fiscal period, G/L account, and key figures. The key figures are a compilation of central characteristics including amounts in rounding difference, ideal value, and amount in currency. App Name: Set Financial Plan Data to Zero
App Description: Data consistency is key to the quality of financial plan data. There are several reasons why you need to correct your plan data. For example, a data import may contain incorrect or obsolete data, or you may want to clean up plan data before going live.   You use this app to remove plan values without deleting them from the database, that is, the system writes delta records and sets the values to zero. In this way, you can for example correct previous plan data imports that contained outdated data to ensure the consistency of your plan data. For example, you want to reduce costs because of cost-saving measures and make the changes visible in your current plan data version.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Controlling Apps: Fiori Apps

App Description: You can use the  Compress Financial Plan Data  app to compress financial plan data items. The app allows you to reduce the number of plan data items stored in planning table  ACDOCP . All changes in financial plan data items are tracked at different times (using timestamps). Compressing plan data items deletes the history of changes permanently and irrevocably and retains only the latest snapshot of the plan data at the current point in time. Using this app to compress plan data can reduce the size of table  ACDOCP , which can improve the overall performance of planning processes.   Note that the application does not delete existing plan data. Only the history of changes is deleted. After compression, all plan data remains consistent.

App Name: Revenue Recognition for Projects: Temporary Adjustments
App Description: With event-based revenue recognition, the costs and revenues associated with project-based transactions are recognized as they occur, enabling real-time reporting. Cost postings are matched to revenues of the period and immediately reported as expenses, while revenues are immediately posted to an income statement account. Recognition and adjustment postings are generated simultaneously with the transactions.  The revenue recognition process is fully integrated with G/L.  Revenue recognition data is stored in the same location as cost and revenue data, hence there is no need to run periodic batch jobs for reconciliation.  Costs and revenues always match, reported profit and margins are always up to date. Income statements and cost-of-sales reports can be produced at any time.  To enable enhanced cost management reporting, additional reporting attributes such as Customer or Customer Group are derived for every revenue recognition journal entry and for income statement / P L items.  With Co-Pilot, you can quickly enter temporary adjustments to the cost of sales or recognized revenue. You can also collaborate and share context with collections of notes, business objects and screenshots.

App Description: This app enables you to analyze the revenue allocated to the performance obligations in a multiple-element arrangement involving bundled deliverables as per the requirements of  IFRS 15/ASC606 Revenue from Contracts with Customers .       Note     This app only displays values for allocated revenues if IFRS 15 bundling functionality has been activated in your solution.     The app supports customer project and sell-from-stock transactions as well as provider contracts.       For customer projects, multiple-element arrangements for the  Fixed Price  and  Periodic Service  contract types are supported.      For sell-from-stock processes, multiple-element arrangements for the following item categories are supported:        TAN : Standard item       TAD : Service item       CB1 : Third party with shipping notification       CB2 : Third party without shipping notification       CB1C : Third party variant configuration with shipping notification       CB2C : Third party variant configuration without shipping notification       CBTC : Configuration at material level       TAQ : Pricing at header level       CBXN : Free of charge enhancement          Note     In sell-from-stock processes, allocated revenue is supported only for  delivery-related billing .   Scenarios including the following are not supported:       Periodic billing      Milestone billing      Intercompany processes      Customer returns      Credit or debit memos      Bill of material (BOM) with the item category group  CPFH            For provider contracts, only items with  one-time  or  recurring  charge types are supported.

App Description: With this app, a  Production Operator  can create, edit, and delete waste transfer requests. Waste transfer requests are the starting point for disposal processing. In the waste transfer request, you document the point of generation of the waste product, related waste stream and disposal channel, date of the transfer request, and the quantity of waste that was produced (this includes amount and unit of measure).   Note    The waste transfer request can only be deleted if it is in status  New  and has no reference documents.     The waste transfer request also contains the data required for disposal processing. Waste transfer requests serve as a notification that waste can be moved from the point of generation. If a storage location has been specified for the waste product, the waste product will be moved from the point of generation to a central collection point or to a local collection point. It will later be moved from the collection point to a disposal facility by the transporter. If no storage location has been specified, the waste product will be moved from the point of generation to the disposal facility by the transporter.   Note    Only a user with the role  Production Operator  ( SAP_BR_PRODN_OPTR_EHS_INFO ) assigned to a location, classified as a point of generation, can create, edit, and delete waste transfer requests using this app.

The waste transfer request also contains the data required for disposal processing. Waste transfer requests serve as a notification that waste can be moved from the point of generation. If a storage location has been specified, the waste product will be moved from the point of generation to a central collection point or to a local collection point. It will later be moved from the collection point to a disposal facility by the transporter. If no storage location has been specified, the waste product will be moved directly from the point of generation to the disposal facility by the transporter. App Description:
The Manage Withholding Tax Items (MWTI) app is introduced that helps you to manage withholding tax items in SAP S/4HANA Cloud and S/4HANA. Using this app, you (GL Accountant, Tax Consultant, or AP Manager) can include or exclude the accounting documents from the reporting period, if required. You can include or exclude one or more documents from a specific tax reporting period by changing the withholding tax reporting date. 
 Note that, you can"t revise the updatable documents, if you identify them after the reporting period close. However, using the MWTI app, you can submit the correct documents either by reversing the reporting period, posting credit memo, or generating the withholding tax advanced compliance report in correction run. For detailed information about different scenarios, refer to the following explanations. 
 
 If you haven"t reported the document to the tax authorities, you can perform the following tasks:
 
 Exclude the document 
 Post Credit Memo/Delta posting to correct the data 
 Report the documents in the next reporting period 
 
 
 
 
 If you have reported the incorrect documents to the tax authorities, you can perform the following tasks:
 
 Post Credit Memo/Delta posting in a new reporting period 
 Change the withholding tax reporting date to the previous period using the MWTI app 
 Get the correction run for the ACR reports in which delta posting will be picked and reported.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Globalization - ACR Apps: Fiori Apps

App Description:
Utility to Copy the Additional Metadata Values  
 
 You can now choose to apply the selected metadata of an element for similar elements using the option Apply Mapping while assigning data sources to the target elements defined in the schema.

  Support for CDS Entities

App Name: Transfer Business Partner Postings to External Systems
UI Technology: SAP Fiori: Generic Job Scheduling Framework
App Description: Using the  Transfer Business Partner Postings and Payments  asynchronous SOAP API provided with the communication scenario  Finance - Contract Accounting Open Item Management Integration  ( SAP_COM_0361 ), you can forward information about business partner postings to external systems.   The outbound SOAP API for postings to the business partner is based on the creation of trigger entries at the time of posting. Whenever you require data in an external system, you schedule a job run with the  Transfer Business Partner Postings to External Systems  (F8476) app. This transfers the data to the external system using trigger records. To enable the infrastructure to correctly determine the receiver of the message, each message contains data for only one receiver system and the ID of that receiver system.       Example     You do not enter documents directly in the SAP system, but instead transfer them from one or more systems using an interface. These systems are dependent on information being returned, such as incoming payments or reversals, in order to be able to react in follow-on processes.   In telecommunications companies, external billing systems print the invoices. In addition to the invoice items, further information, such as charge postings or incoming payments are displayed on the invoice. To make this information available for the invoice, the billing system requires the complete current account balance of the business partner and information about incoming payments and document clearing.   In Public Sector, it is often the case that several external systems are connected to the SAP system. Invoices from different areas are transferred to Contract Accountig using the interfaces of these systems. Examples are trade tax, childcare contributions, or receivables from minor offenses. These systems are dependent on information from Contract Accounting about the postings to the business partners to trigger follow-on processes in the case of missing or late incoming payments (for example, conversion of a minor offense into a fine). There are certain special considerations in these cases. When you transfer business partner postings to the external system, for reasons of data protection you should consider that only data relevant for the respective external system is allowed to be transferred. For example, information about trade tax must not be transferred to the system that manages minor offenses, and vice versa. This means that in these cases, only parts of the account balance of a business partner and never the entire balance should be transferred to an external system. You can keep the data separate using the contract account or contract.

UI Technology: SAP Fiori: Generic Job Scheduling Framework
App Description: In the  Print Correspondence  app you can schedule new jobs with the  FI-CA Print Correspondence  template as follows:       Under  Scheduling Options , you can decide whether you want to start the run immediately, or schedule it to occur later. You define a recurrence pattern for periodic correspondence.      Under  Run ID , in the  Run ID Prefix  field, you define a run ID that you use to identify the run at a later time.      Under  Selections , on the basis of general selections you can restrict the correspondence to specific business partners, contract accounts, contracts, and company codes. Based on the entries made for the correspondence selections, you can restrict the output to specific correspondence types. For information about the correspondence types, see  Mass Creation of Correspondence .      Choose a print mode under  print parameters :       Sample printout   The test print only selects records for which the print date has not yet been set.   A trial print leaves the print date blank.   Sample printouts can therefore be repeated as often as required.      Actual printing   The actual print only selects records for which the print date has not yet been set.   The actual print sets the print date to the current date.   You can therefore only perform an actual print once.      Repeat printing   The repeat print only selects records for which the print date has already been set.   The repeat print set the print date to the value of that of the actual print.   You can therefore repeat prints as often as you want.      The option of a test or repeat print is not available for all correspondence types. In this way, you cannot print test checks or reprints, for example.   If necessary, specify the output channel and either a print queue or an output queue if you are using the output channel  EXTOM  ( External Output Management ).   If dispatch control is defined for a correspondence (see  Control Maintenance Using Attributes in the Contract Account or the Contract ), its settings for the output channel and queue (print or output queue) take precedence. During a test print, this print or output queue can be overridden.      Schedule the run.   For parallel processing, the system divides the data into ranges according to business partners.   The app transfers the data to the output control.

App Description: Provided you are using SAP digital payments add-on, you can now also create payment orders for card payments.  The payment run creates payment orders as part of digital payment transactions whenever a payment method is selected that is indicated accordingly. In this case, the payment run does not post a payment document, but creates a payment card order and also posts a clearing document "Card Account to Clearing Account". You then schedule a settlement run that selects this document and reports the payment to the payment service provider. You periodically import the response from the payment service provider (payment advice note) and process the payment advice note. As a final process step, using the  Post Payment Card Order Lot  app, you create payment card order lots. The run creates and posts lots, clears the receivable on the clearing account, and sets the payment card orders to  Executed.

App Name: Maintain Number of Units for UoP Depreciation
App Description:
You can use the units-of-production method of depreciation (UoP depreciation). The app "Maintain Number of Units for UoP Depreciation" is available thereto and the master data record section of the "Manage Fixed Assets" app has been enhanced. You can create a usage object in the app "Maintain Number of Units for UoP Depreciation". Once the usage object is created, you use the "Manage Fixed Assets" app to assign one or more fixed assets to the usage object. In the app "Maintain Number of Units for UoP Depreciation", you maintain the following input data for the usage object: 
 
 You enter the expected total number of units for a freely-defined time interval. 
 You regularly enter the actual number of units per period. You also do this for freely-defined time intervals. 
 
Based on your input data (number of units), the specific depreciation keys, and the asset value (either acquisition cost or net book value), the system then calculates the period depreciation. In so doing, all assets assigned to the usage object are depreciated with the same factor for a given period.

App Name: Post Asset Acquisition - And Quantity Adjustment
App Description:
The "Post Asset Aquisition" app is a SAP Fiori app (F6488). With this app, you make postings for the following Asset Accounting transactions: 
 
  Acquisition:  You post an acquisition document for the asset that you have purchased. 
 
 
  Post-capitalization:  Post-capitalizations are subsequent corrections to the acquisition cost of a fixed asset. Business Example: You capitalize your asset that you accidentally posted to an expense account. 
 
  Credit memo : You post a credit memo, whereby the actual purchasing and invoicing have taken place either in the current fiscal year or in a prior fiscal year. 
 
 
  Quantity adjustment : In the case of an adjustment posting for quantities, the system only adjusts the quantity up or down, but it does not change the book value. 
 
 
  
  Note:  You can only use this app if you have activated the business function   Universal Parallel Accounting   (FINS_PARALLEL_ACCOUNTING_BF, short: UPA).

App Name: Cash Flow Statement - Indirect Method (Design Studio)
App Description: This app enables you to display a cash flow statement based on the indirect calculation method.   You can display real-time information about your cash flow. Depending on your requirements, you can add columns or rows to get more detailed information about individual accounts.   The cash flow total is calculated as follows:    Cash flow  =  cash flow from operating activities  +  cash flow from investing activities  +  cash flow from financing activities    Where:          Cash flow from operating activities  = net profit (or loss) + adjustments for income and expenses not involving cash flows - decrease in balance sheet items + increase in value in the balance sheet items         The calculation is based on the semantic tags assigned to the relevant G/L accounts. For more information, see  Assign Semantic Tags for Cash Flow Statement .

App Description: You can use this app to create, display, edit, and delete recurring journal entries. It also lets you trigger due postings, and to review the posting status and planned postings for recurring journal entries.   A recurring journal entry is a business transaction that is repeated regularly, for example, the deferral of costs or revenues for an invoice where the same amount is posted over a period of 12 months. It consists of a template journal entry and a recurrence rule attached to it. A recurring journal entry by itself is not a journal entry; rather, you trigger the posting of journal entries from it. In other words, a recurring journal entry is comparable to a standing order at a bank.   You can copy an existing journal entry to use as a template to create other recurring journal entries to which you want to apply the same rules.   To make your work more efficient, you can personalize the layout of the table, predefine recurring queries, and save your settings as variants.   You can perform the following tasks if you have the business role  G/L Accountant :     Create, display, edit, and delete recurring journal entries     Create and modify recurrence rules for journal entries to be posted     Find recurring journal entries using a range of search criteria     Trigger postings of journal entries when due     Review the posting status and planned postings of recurring journal entries     Copy a recurring journal entry to use as a template for other recurring journal entries     Personalize the layout of data in the table      Export data to a spreadsheet     Share recurring journal entry data and other information by email        Note    It isn’t supported to post intercompany recurring journal entries with this app.

App Description: The application enables you to verify the following information:    How much revenue is recognized?     When was fulfillment trigged and how many quantities are delivered, or manually fulfilled?     What kind of attributes related to the revenue recognition exist, such as Allocated Amount and Fulfilled Quantity?     How much revenue catch-up is recognized?     What kind of events trigger the revenue recognition?       You can verify the result of price allocation for a revenue contract by following these steps:    Open the  Revenue Explanation  Fiori App.     Search for your performance obligations.     Click on a particular performance obligation to review the revenue recognition. The POBs are grouped by Fiscal Year Period.     The Recognized Revenue is arranged by different Revenue Adjustment Reason. You can analyze the Recognized Revenue based on the different Revenue Adjustment Reasons as follows:     Fulfillment  – Revenue recognized based on fulfillments. If you click the line item of Fulfillment, detailed fulfillment entries are displayed:     For distinct performance obligations, fulfillment details include Fulfillment Date, Fulfilled Quantity, and Fulfillment Document.     For compound group performance obligations, fulfillment details of the compound group and non-distinct performance obligations are displayed.         Catch-up  – Revenue Catch-up is displayed as Recognized Revenue when retrospective changes occur, such as an update to the standalone selling price that triggers a contract change with retrospective mode. If you click the line item of Catch-up, change logs of the retrospective changes are displayed with Field Name, New Value, and Old Value.    For distinct performance obligations, change logs of the retrospective changes are displayed along with Field Name, New Value, and Old Value.     For compound group performance obligations, Revenue Catch-up of non-distinct performance obligations within the compound structure is also displayed with the change logs.          Contract Modification  – Revenue recognition is impacted when any contract modification occurs. If you click the line item of Contract Modification, change logs are displayed for the contract modification. If you want to know what happened for the Allocated Amount on the Contract Modification line, you can click the hyper-link for the Allocated Amount. You are then able to check the detailed explanation in the  Allocated Amount Explanation  application.

App Description: The system tracks changes that occur in certain fields of revenue contracts and performance obligations. The certain fields are grouped by document number and sorted in descending order based on the Document Number, Revenue Contract, and Performance Obligation by default. You can track the change logs by taking the following steps:      Open the SAP Fiori App  Display Change History .     Search the change logs for your revenue contracts or some change fields.  For example, If you would like to understand when the contract status of a revenue contract is changed and what kind of contract change triggers the contract status update. Then you can input your revenue contract and set  Table Name  as  FARR_D_CONTRACT (Contracts)  and set  Field Name  as  STATUS .     In the results list, you can view the following information:     When the contract status is changed by looking at the field  Changed On      Whether the contract change is a manual transaction or operational transaction by looking at the field  Manual Transaction      What kind of a contract change caused the contract status update by looking at the field  Transaction Name      The change context of the contract status by looking at the fields  New Value  and  Old Value      Who triggered the contract status change by looking at the field  Changed By            Note    Change history data may be archived and the archived data is not displayed in the  Display Change History  app.

App Description: With this app, you can create and manage journal upload cases. You can find, filter and sort the journal upload cases according to your requirements. You can include various attributes such as the name, description, case category, case subcategory, transactional data, etc., while creating the journal upload case. The system generates a journal entry proposal based on the information that you have provided. During the creation of a journal case, you are required to select a case category and case subcategory. The system associates the appropriate posting policy according to the category and subcategory details given in the journal upload case and generates the journal entry proposal for the uploaded transactions by using generative AI. This automated proposal process removes the need for you to manually create journal entries for individual financial transactions. You can review the generated journal entry proposals, fill in missing information, and modify incorrect entries. The system supports mass editing of proposals. You can download proposals as spreadsheet files, make changes offline, and upload them back into the system. You can trigger the validation process, and the system validates the entries. You can then submit the proposals for approval. Once approved, you post the journal entries to the system. The system can automatically reverse posted journal entries using scheduled background jobs. You can also manually trigger reversals if needed.

App Name: My Inbox - Review Purchase Order Accruals
App Description: With this My Inbox app, you can review purchase order accruals and adjust accrual amounts. For purchase order accruals, you can choose to have accrual amounts reviewed and approved before the system posts them. A reviewer can then check the periodic planned costs that the system proposes and adjust them if needed.   The system calculates periodic accrual amounts as follows:   Accrual amounts = Planned Costs - Actual Costs   Planned costs are proposed amounts that are calculated periodically over the lifetime of an item using an accrual method. Actual costs are based on the receipt value or the invoice value of received goods or services.

App Description: This app allows you to control the overall process for an organizational change. For example, you can use this app to divide up, combine, and replace profit centers that are assigned to objects. You also decide which objects are affected by new profit center assignments. Objects that are affected by the reorganization, such as WBS elements or products, are then reassigned and their stocks or balances are reposted to the new organizational entities.

App Name: Statutory Reporting / Israel WHT Reporting / Pending Reports
App Description:
Utility to Copy the Additional Metadata Values  
 
 You can now choose to apply the selected metadata of an element for similar elements using the option Apply Mapping while assigning data sources to the target elements defined in the schema. 
 
  Support for Data Type ABAP numC  
 
 The ABAP data type numC will now be saved as the XSD built-in type abap:numC while creating a new schema or during reparsing of an existing schema. The validations for this data type have also been added. It is recommended that while reparsing an existing schema, you check the mapping and adjust the values or data types accordingly to avoid any errors during file generation. 
 
  Enabling Continuous Page Numbering Across PDF File Outputs  
 
 You can now satisfy legal requirements with regards to continuous page numbering of multiple split PDF files from the first file to the last file. 
 
  Data Type Based Checks in Design Time  
 
 Certain checks are introduced in design time to validate any data type incompatibility between mapping fields and the data sources assigned them in both query mapping (query filters, parameters, and conditions) and document mapping. These type-based checks are executed when the report is verified. 
 
  Support for CDS Entities  
 
 If you assign a CDS View Column to an element as additional metadata, then in Preview you can have value help (F4 help) from which you can choose the required values. The values will be returned from the assigned CDS view/column.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Globalization - ACR Apps: Fiori Apps

App Name: Statutory Reporting / Israel Asset Accounting Reporting / Pending Reports
App Description:
Managing Fraction Digits  
 
 You can modify the currency fields in you report and control the number of decimals displayed during report generation using the field  Number of Decimals for Currency Amounts . The default number of decimals are taken from the data source initially, which can later be modified as required. Based on the adjustment done, during preview, the values are validated against the data already given during preview. The ability to customize fraction digits are enabled only for CDS, ABAP Dictionary, or query-based documents. 
  
 
  Enabling Schema changes  
 
 You can now easily view the selected CDS fields during schema creation in the  CDS Field Selection  dialog. Additionally, you can view the selected fields while editing the schema as well. 
  
 
  Enabling Activity Group for activities  
 
 You can categorize similar reporting activities into a single group based on their functions. Assigning reporting activities into groups help when you want to perform some additional actions, such as identifying a specific reporting activity based on the group they are allotted to. The activity group value assigned to the reporting activity group will be available in the  Run   Compliance Reports  app and based on this value, appropriate business checks can be processed. 
     
 
  New Organizational Units  
 
 Two new organizational units  Profit Center  and  Segment  are introduced in  SAP S/4HANA Cloud . These new options can be used as a replacement for  Business Area  while defining report category. 
     
 
  New statuses for documents  
 
 The  Document Status  column is enhanced with two new statuses such as  In Process (Editing)  and  In Process (Regeneration) .  In Process (Editing)  status appears when the document is saved with manual changes and  In Process (Regeneration) status  appears when the document is being regenerated. 
     
 
  Enhancement to Balance Sheet/Income Statement (GENC_FINSTMNT_RET)  
 
 The generic report definition  Balance Sheet/Income Statement  is enhanced so that the search help of parameter  Currency Type  (CURRENCYROLE) supports all currency types, including functional currency.

App Description:
You can now compress your files during report generation using the configuration parameter  SRF_ENABLE_OUTPUT_COMPRESSION . The values of this configuration parameter is stored in the configuration activity  Setting Up Your Statutory Reporting  for your reporting entity. Whenever you generate a new run, you can see if compression has been applied in the run log.   
 You can update the status of reporting activities enabled as reporting entity activities once, and it will be reflected across all reporting tasks related to that reporting entity and period where this activity is assigned. To do so, you must set the option  Reporting Entity Activity  to  ON  when creating a reporting activity.   
 This option is only applicable for supporting activities and is enabled for the reporting activity type  SAP Fiori Application . 
 Using the  Mass Action  feature in the  Run Statutory Reports  app, you can now create report runs for a group of reports in one go.  You can now add or delete rows of data in a nested table using the option  Add  and  Delete .   
 Improved validation checks for mandatory elements and date/time fields.   
 For choice elements, in addition to the flexibility to choose which child node is to be displayed in the output file, now you also have ability to choose multiple child nodes to be displayed in the output file. For more information, refer to  Generator Version .   
 You can enable parallelization for sections within documents for faster and more efficient report generation.

App Description:
Starting with S/4HANA 1909, customers can use an optimized version of the Revenue Accounting contract management. 
 The optimized contract management focuses on performance optimizations and additional features, such as day-based contract modifications. 
 The optimized contract management can be released for new contracts based on a new contract category defined in customizing: Revenue Accounting -  Revenue Accounting Contracts -  Select Contract Management for Contract Categories

 Support for day-based contract modifications 
 Early termination with impairment of assets 
 Freeze and unfreeze revenue recognition of performance obligations

App Description: You can make manual changes to correct attributes without changing the operational document, customizing, or the BRFplus rules. However, the back-end operational system may still request more changes to the performance obligations after the manual change is made. A conflict may then occur because the system cannot determine whether the manual or operational value should be used. For example, this may occur when a change is made to the corresponding sales order. If you and the back-end system have changed the same attribute, a conflict occurs. In this scenario, the system puts the contract with conflicting changes on the  Conflicted Revenue Contracts Worklist  user interface. You can review the list and resolve the conflicts on the UI.   You can resolve conflicts by following these steps:    Open the Fiori App  Conflicted Revenue Contracts Worklist .     Search for your conflicted revenue contracts and click on a revenue contract to view the next page with details about the conflicted attributes.     Click  Edit  in the upper right corner to enter edit mode.     When you choose to accept either of the following, please make sure you always choose the desired value for all POBs in a contract as the system will not accept partial conflict resolution:     Value from the Operational Document     Value from Manual Change        Click  Resolve Conflicts  to now save your changes and after your selection below, the POB status and revenue contract status will be set to  In Process .     If you choose a value from the manual change, then you have the option to select a  Business Change Reason  within the  Confirmation  pop-up window. The effective date remains the same as the effective date from the last contract change that was performed. If you do not select any  Business Change Reason  from the confirmation pop-up window, the Business Change Reason is taken from the last contract change instead.     If you choose all values from operational document, then you will solve the conflict directly without providing any Business Change Reason. This is because you accept the current attributes of all performance obligations (POBs) without making any contract change.        Click  Cancel  to discard your changes.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Finance - Revenue Accounting: Fiori Apps

App Description: You can use the  Clean Up Productive Data  SAP Fiori app and the transaction  FARR_PROD_CLEANUP  ( Clean Up and Reverse the Productive Data ) to clean up RAIs (revenue accounting items) and relevant revenue contracts that are related to header IDs coming from the following sender components:     Sales and Distribution (SD)       Convergent Invoicing       Service  and      External sender components.     The Productive Cleanup program handles the selected data as follows:     If the revenue contracts do not have any postings, the program deletes the data that is created in Revenue Accounting directly.     If the revenue contracts already have postings, the program reverses the postings to the general ledger to ensure that the data in the general ledger and Revenue Accounting can still be reconciled. All other data is deleted.       Note    To ensure that the data in Revenue Accounting and the general ledger are reconciled for revenue contracts that already have postings, the program only stores data that is related to the original posting and the reversed posting, to the general ledger in shadow tables ( FARR_D_POSTING_S  and  FARR _D_RECKEY_S ).  There are objects and related database tables in Revenue Accounting that have no direct relation to a header ID. Therefore, this program cannot delete entries from these database tables.     Note    For  Revenue Accounting and Reporting (Classic) : This program only applies to company codes that are set to  Productive  for all accounting principles.  If you used transition, you can rerun the  Calculate Cumulative Catch-up for Transition  program (transaction  FARR_TRANS_CATCHUP ) with the attribute  Force New Run  to ignore the existing entries in the  FARR_D_TRANS_REC  table.

App Name: Manage Substitution and Validation - For Asset Postings
App Description:
As of SAP S/4HANA OP2025, the app   Manage Substitution and Validation Rules - For Asset Postings   (F7699) is available. With this app, you can use validation and substitution rules in the following ways: 
 
 In  validation rules , you can define how the system should check values that the user has entered for an asset posting. You can specify that the system issues a warning or error message if a certain precondition is met. For example, you want the system to issue an error message if a settlement is to be made to an asset with a specific asset class. 
 In  substitution rules , you can define under which preconditions you want the system to fill or overwrite (replace) certain fields in the document header. This means that you can define preconditions and the substitution itself, that is, the system reaction. 
 
Validation and substitution rules affect both manual postings and automatic postings (for example, automatic postings using APIs or the SAP S/4HANA migration cockpit for legacy data transfer).  For more details see,  Manage Substitution and Validation Rules - For Asset Postings | SAP Help Portal

App Description: Depending on the approval type selected for tasks, they can be subject to dual control. That means that they need to be approved by a user other than the processing user after they were processed. The approval type is assigned on task level and doesn't apply to the task list.   For every task of a closing task list, one of the following approval types is selected:     No Approval Required   The task does not require approval before it can be completed.      Completed Approval Required   The task requires explicit approval before it can be completed and is therefore subject to dual control. The successor tasks are on hold until the approval is granted.      Pending Approval Required   The task is subject to approval and therefore to dual control. However, pending approval does not cause subsequent closing steps to be delayed.

The  Closing Task Completion  app is an analytical list page that offers different options to analyze and display data. You can filter for information to analyze the data using different chart types and table options.   For example, you can filter for tasks completed with errors restricted to a specific company code to get a list of all corresponding tasks and display the processing user, the user responsible, or the corresponding user groups.

Use this app to see the changes made to task list templates, task lists, and tasks. You can see what was changed, by whom, and when. You can filter by the type of change (deletion, insertion, or change). You can also filter for changes made to a particular task list template, task list, or task, or by a particular user.

The closing cycle for a closing key date is represented by a task list. Each task list carries attributes such as the description, closing type, overall progress, and number of tasks in your responsibility. You can schedule or process tasks that have the status  Released  or  Active . You can change the task status for each task separately or for multiple tasks at once. The app automatically updates the status of jobs. When processing tasks, you can create comments regarding your changes and add attachments. All actions are logged to provide a complete audit trail.

A range of filters help you to get an overview of the status and progress of the active closing cycles. If there are issues or delays, you can jump to the relevant apps and drill down to the details to find the root cause or to identify the person responsible.
With the  Manage Users  app, you can create, edit, and delete users.

With the  Manage Compliance Settings  app, you can define several compliance settings, such as anonymizing names in emails and task lists, user notification time, and whether or not SOX compliance is required.

With the  Manage User Roles  app, you can create user roles to specify the objects and organizational units to which users have access. User roles are created within a specific scope to allow you to split responsibility between task list creation and task processing.
You can use this app to change the configuration of advanced financial closing by setting up authorization groups, country/region groups, e-mail notification scenarios, user groups or user roles.

To perform your financial close, you connect one or more financial communication systems to  SAP Advanced Financial Closing . For your financial close to work, the connection to the systems has to work and data has to be synchronized successfully. That's why this app also offers several options to check the system settings. The  Specify Communication Systems  app also allows you to define notification settings for different scenarios.

With the  Manage Country/Region Groups (Deprecated)  app, you can create and edit country/region groups that allow you to monitor the completion rate and status of financial close activities on the level of these country/region groups.

With the  Manage Email Notification Configurations  app, you can create several email notification configurations and assign a set of email notification scenarios to a task list. A notification configuration also controls when and how users assigned in different roles are notified.
With the  Manage User Groups  app, you can create groups of users that you can then assign to tasks or task lists collectively as owners, users responsible, processing users, or interested users.
With the  Manage User Role Assignments  app, you can assign users to user roles to grant them authorizations defined in the user role.
With the  Manage Authorization Groups  app, you can create and edit authorization groups that you use to grant users access to specific objects, such as tasks or task list templates and task lists.

You start the financial close workflow for each closing cycle by generating and releasing a task list related to a specific key date.

App Description: This analytical app displays the financial status of a company or group of companies on a specific key date and allows you to drill down to individual financial positions. These financial positions can have either of the following data sources based on user-defined parameters:       Treasury position management  for treasury positions from  Treasury and Risk Management         One exposure  for bank account balances from  Cash Management         One document balances  for account balances from the general ledger     Each financial position represents either a specific asset or liability position. Financial position groups are used to structure how financial positions are displayed in the  Financial Status  app. The financial position groups of the assets are displayed followed by the financial position groups for the liabilities and the not specified positions.     Note    The financial positions and financial position groups defined for the data source  Facilities  for the credit lines from  Treasury and Risk Management , are not relevant for the financial status app. For these financial positions representing the credit lines from Treasury and Risk Management the asset liability indicator is not specified. You can report these financial positions using the CDS query  Financial Status Query  ( C_FinancialStatusQuery ).      Note    This app offers a Web Dynpro version and a Design Studio version. Starting with SAP S/4HANA 2021, the Design Studio version of this app is deprecated. The Design Studio version will no longer be available with SAP S/4HANA 2022. If you aren’t already doing so, please switch to the Web Dynpro version of this app now.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Treasury and Risk Management: All Apps

App Description: With this app, you can analyze your balance sheet FX risk. The app reads open items and balances in foreign currency of your G/L accounts in  Financial Accounting  (FX exposure), financial transaction data from the  Transaction Manager  (hedging instruments), and operational data from  One Exposure . The app enables you to analyze details of balance sheet FX risk by adding attributes (for example, related to financial transactions, bank accounts and general ledger postings) to the content area as rows or columns.   The  Balance Sheet FX Risk  tile displays balance sheet the FX risk measures absolute exposures, absolute hedges, and absolute net exposures as well as hedge amounts and exposure amounts on the level of the company codes in display currency. It allows you to analyze the values by adding attributes as rows to get these values on lower levels also.     Note    This app offers a Web Dynpro version and a Design Studio version. Starting with SAP S/4HANA 2021, the Design Studio version of this app is deprecated. The Design Studio version will no longer be available with SAP S/4HANA 2022. If you aren’t already doing so, please switch to the Web Dynpro version of this app now.
Technical Catalog Title: SAP Financials - Treasury and Risk Management: All Apps

App Name: Balance Sheet FX Risk - In Transaction Currency (Design Studio)
App Description: With this app, you can analyze your balance sheet FX risk. The app reads open items and balances in foreign currency of your G/L accounts in  Financial Accounting  (currency exposure), financial transaction data from the  Transaction Manager  (hedging instruments), and operational data from  One Exposure . The app allows you to analyze details of balance sheet FX risk by adding attributes related to financial transaction, bank accounts, and general ledger postings to the content area as rows or columns.    The  Balance Sheet FX Risk - In Transaction Currency  tile directly displays the measures for balance sheet FX risk with the amounts in transaction currency for all selected currencies and company codes and obtains a detailed view of the origin/structure of the exposures and hedges for the various transaction currencies (amounts in transaction currency).     Note    This app offers a Web Dynpro version and a Design Studio version. Starting with SAP S/4HANA 2021, the Design Studio version of this app is deprecated. The Design Studio version will no longer be available with SAP S/4HANA 2022. If you aren’t already doing so, please switch to the Web Dynpro version of this app now.
